topic: Run release-grade validation for current HEAD

STRATEGY-001.title: Assess current HEAD and define release-grade test plan
STRATEGY-001.findings: Use existing repo gates only. Strict Windows packaging applies in this checkout because the packaged compatibility sidecar artifact is present. Execution order: governance fast-fail, src-ts check:local, desktop check:local plus local:selftest, packaging dry-run, then writing-helper acceptance and release summary evidence refresh.

TESTRUN-001.title: Execute src-ts release validation lane
TESTRUN-001.findings: src-ts release validation lane passed. `npm --prefix src-ts run check:local` exited 0 in 50.688s and reported lint, format, typecheck, phase4 coverage 94.87% statements / 80.8% branches, plus release vitest 4 files and 10 tests passed. The targeted runtime pair exited 0 in 10.545s with 2 files and 4 tests passed. The workflow integration pair exited 0 in 8.928s with 2 files and 6 tests passed. Total lane duration: 70161 ms.

TESTRUN-002.title: Execute desktop release validation lane
TESTRUN-002.findings: Desktop release validation lane passed. `npm --prefix desktop run check:local` exited 0 in 79.407s and completed lint, format check, Vitest, sidecar build/contract validation, and desktop build. `npm --prefix desktop run local:selftest` exited 0 in 20.428s and reported Self-test: PASS. `npm --prefix desktop run validate:sidecar-contract` exited 0 in 0.827s with strict PASS. Total lane duration: 100662 ms.

TESTRUN-003.title: Execute governance fast-fail lane
TESTRUN-003.findings: Governance fast-fail lane passed. `delivery_gate.py` and `check_authority_alignment.py` exited 0; authority alignment reported PASS with 92/92 rules and no mismatches. Targeted pytest exited 0 with 11 passed in 0.30s. Total lane duration: 6170 ms. Logs and structured results written under session/results.

TESTRUN-004.title: Execute final release proof lane
TESTRUN-004.findings: Final release proof lane failed. `npm --prefix desktop run validate:package:dry-run` exited 0 in 54.497s and `python scripts/release_check_summary.py` exited 0 in 170.252s with `Decision: GO`, but `./scripts/check-writing-helper.ps1 -Strict -Port 18080 -Host 127.0.0.1` exited 1 immediately because the script has a PowerShell parse error from garbled text. Managed gateway PID 57212 was stopped; a pre-existing node.exe PID 45200 remained on port 18080 and was left untouched. Total lane duration: 247413 ms.
TESTRUN-004.error: writing_helper_acceptance_strict failed: PowerShell parse error in scripts/check-writing-helper.ps1

TESTANA-001.title: Aggregate release validation results
TESTANA-001.findings: Current HEAD is NO_GO for release from this session. Governance, src-ts, and desktop lanes passed, but the strategy-defined strict writing-helper acceptance gate failed immediately because scripts/check-writing-helper.ps1 contains garbled text that triggers a PowerShell parse error. Packaging dry-run and release_check_summary.py both passed, but that GO evidence is incomplete relative to the blocking gate set.
